Subject: Mutual action plan + acceptance tests — operational runbook draft

Hi Priyanka —

Attached is a focused MAP and the acceptance-test checklist that reflect our agreed scope for the 6-week evaluation. High level:

- Goal: Validate inference accuracy and 95th pct latency under your representative load; establish a handoff for production readiness.
- Timeline: Week 0 kickoff, Week 1 instrumented smoke tests, Weeks 2–4 workload soak + quality validation, Week 5 final regression + security review, Week 6 signoff/cutover plan.

Key acceptance gates called out in the sheet:
1) Functional: accuracy >= 91% on the curated prompt set (see eval-acceptance-tests.md)
2) Performance: p95 latency < 400ms on the 90% of traffic profile we discussed
3) Reliability: < 1% token error rate, auto-failover exercised in canary region
4) Security & data handling: logs retained in your VPC, no customer PII persisted by Redwood runtime

Owners are inline on the sheet — we propose Marissa owns quality validation, Ben owns performance tuning & autoscaling, and Laura will coordinate procurement evidence for your security/compliance checklist.

Ask: Please review the attached MAP and the acceptance-tests doc; can you confirm by end of day Thursday whether the accuracy threshold and the timeline look OK? If procurement needs any edits, loop them in and we’ll update the DocuSign.

Attachments: 20270425-MAP-draft.xlsx; eval-acceptance-tests.md

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher

Sean / team —

Thanks for the draft; overall this aligns with our expectations. Two quick clarifications before I sign off:

1) Accuracy baseline: The 91% target is fine for the curated clinical prompts, but we need an explicit fail-case plan if accuracy drops below 88% on any major cohort (diagnoses, medication reconciliation). Can you add a rollback/mitigation step in the MAP?

2) Security evidence: Procurement wants explicit confirmation that KV cache and prefix caching do not persist PHI beyond session TTL and that we will provide the SOC 2 artifact they requested (type II). They’ve been cc’d.

Procurement — please confirm the DocuSign recipient list and whether the standard PO language is sufficient; if not, flag the clause numbers you want changed and we’ll loop legal.

Assuming the two points above are worked into the plan, I can sign the MAP on Thursday.

Best,
Priyanka

Priyanka — thanks for the quick review and excellent flags. I made three concrete edits in eval-acceptance-tests.md and the MAP spreadsheet; summary below and I've attached the updated md for quick scanning.

Edits / clarifications:
- Fail-case & rollback: Added a "go/no-go" decision node at the Week 4 checkpoint. If accuracy < 88% on any major cohort, we enter a 72-hour mitigation window: (a) freeze new prompts to canary, (b) revert to the model variant with the previous validated profile, (c) execute targeted prompt tuning. Owners: Marissa (quality), Ben (variant switching).
- PHI handling: Added explicit language that the runtime does not write KV cache to persistent storage; session TTL will be set to 30 minutes by default for evaluation. We will provide a signed attestation and include the SOC 2 Type II report link in the procurement bundle. Owner: Laura (compliance pack).
- Acceptance test rubric: split the accuracy checks into primary (curated prompts) and secondary (randomized cohort sampling). Primary must meet >= 91%; secondary must not fall below 86% on aggregated cohorts. See table in eval-acceptance-tests.md.

Next steps:
- Sean: can you schedule the Week 0 kickoff for Monday May 3rd? I will prepare the smoke-test templates (owner: Marissa).
- Laura: please prepare the SOC 2 artifact and the short attestation for procurement.

Attachments included: eval-acceptance-tests.md (v2)

Marissa Cole
Director, Product Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
